stories.summary: Samantha Ruth Prabhu and director Raj Nidimoru joyfully welcomed their son, Dev Nidimoru, into the world on November 19. To celebrate this delightful event, Raj's sister, Sheetal, visited three sacred sites to offer prayers for the newborn’s future, sharing her heartfelt wishes on social media. The family commemorated this special occasion with a treat of custard apple cream from Haji Ali Juice Centre.

stories.title: Maharashtra: MSRTC deploys 1,000 additional buses for Kartiki Ekadashi
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) has kept around 1,000 additional buses ready to ferry devotees to Pandharpur for the Kartiki Ekadashi pilgrimage on November 21. With lakhs of Warkaris expected to visit the temple town to seek the blessings of Lord Vitthal, MSRTC focuses on assuring proper facilities to pilgrims.

stories.title: When Is Tulsi Vivah 2026? Know Correct Date, Muhurat, Rituals, Significance And More
stories.summary: Tulsi Vivah is an auspicious Hindu ritual that celebrates the symbolic marriage of the holy Tulsi plant (sacred basil) with Lord Shaligram, a form of Lord Vishnu. This occasion takes place on the 12th day (Dwadashi) of the lunar month, usually in October or November. The festival is mostly observed in Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Maharashtra, Bihar, and Karnataka.
